generation: Two independent fresh agent contexts; same inherited session model; eight prompts identical; model ID, sampling seed and temperature were not exposed
evaluation: Separate fresh reviewer, per-pair A/B randomized with a saved deterministic mapping; one subjective judge
course_source_validation: Full extracted text of 19 lessons read across three source-validation contexts, all 126 block anchors checked against provided subtitles
snapshot_scope: Final frozen working instructions, used for final generation. Initial run retained separately; final prompts were unchanged.
holdout_review: Two new tasks after revisions; reviewed against explicit user requirements by main agent, not blinded
integration_review: Three integration cases executed; self-reported skills_used and manual inspection of raw outputs
